body_text:
Cantor--Schroeder--Bernstein theorem. If there is an injection
$A\to B$ and an injection $B\to A$, then there is a bijection
$A\to B$. Consequently mutual cardinal inequalities imply equal
cardinality without requiring either injection to be surjective.
